description: Biscoff Cookies 🍪 (makes 10 cookies) Ingredients: — 10 tsp Biscoff spread (for filling) — 120 g melted butter — 100 g brown sugar — 50 g white sugar — 1 egg — 1 tsp vanilla extract — 80 g Biscoff spread — 200 g flour — 1/2 tsp baking soda — 1/2 tsp baking powder — pinch of salt — 100 g white chocolate chips (set a few aside for topping) — 100 g crushed Biscoff cookies Instructions: 1. Scoop 10 tsp of Biscoff spread onto baking paper and freeze for at least 2 hours. 2. Mix melted butter with sugars until creamy, then add egg, vanilla and Biscoff spread. 3. Combine flour, baking soda, baking powder, and salt, fold into the mixture. 4. Add white chocolate chips and crushed Biscoff cookies. 5. Flatten 2 tbsp of dough, place a frozen Biscoff center inside, and seal into a ball. 6. Chill dough balls for 1–2 hours (or overnight). 7. Bake at 180 °C / 350 °F for 12 minutes until edges are golden and centers soft. 8. Right after baking, use a cookie cutter to shape them perfectly and top with the reserved chips. #cookies #biscoffcookies #whitechocolate #biscoff selbstgekauft/unbeauftragt
